description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid attacks (0.60 or 1.60 each), grants [Attach Holy 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Instant ATB 3], [Instant Cast 3] and Paladin +1 to the user

description.name: Saint Smash
description.text: Six single hybrid attacks (0.90 or 3.10 each), restores 500 HP to the lowest HP% ally

description.name: Saint Gate
description.text: Three single hybrid attacks (0.90 or 3.10 each), grants [ATK and MND +30%, DEF +25% (8s)] and [Holy Ability +30% Boost 3] to the user if the user has Paladin level 1, grants [Holy Ability +30% Boost 1] to the user if the user has Paladin level 0, causes Paladin -1 to the user

description.name: Attach Holy 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Instant ATB 3
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
